QUOTE: Python never touches the C++ classes. It loads `librentropic.so` with `ctypes` and calls the flat C ABI in `include/entropic/entropic.h`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that ctypes loads librentropic.so and calls the flat C ABI. The item's "no compiled extension module" part is implied by that, since all binding is done through ctypes and `_bindings.py`.
